handoff: Review approved: AC1–AC3 met; full suite 1423 pass and typecheck green; transcripts, snapshots and golden unchanged. No blocking findings. Minor F1: transcript.ts no longer skips unit worktrees' trace dirs (latent). Nit F2: the lint's comment strip.

findings.title: Transcript recorder no longer skips unit worktrees' trace dirs
findings.detail:
Before, the walk skipped any path ending in '/.agents/norn/trace', at any depth. Now it skips only traceDir(top) for each top. The tops are the root and `${root}-worktrees`, so traceDir(`${root}-worktrees`) matches nothing, and a unit worktree's own trace dir (<root>-worktrees/<wt>/.agents/norn/trace) is walked. Nothing records differently today: the transcripts are unchanged, and worktree trace dirs hold no runs/ subtree. But if a worktree trace dir ever gains a runs/ path (for example a base/<tree>/ cache copy of the record), its files would land in the transcripts. The recorder is meant to pin behaviour exactly, so this is a quiet narrowing of it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Skip a dir that is the trace dir of the root two levels up, e.g. `if (p === traceDir(join(p, '..', '..', '..')))`, or test against traceDir of each directory being walked, so that every checkout's trace dir is skipped at any depth.

findings.title: Lint's trailing-comment strip also cuts string text containing ' // '
findings.detail:
nornPathLines strips /\s\/\/ .*$/ before matching, so a line such as `"see http: // x .agents/norn"`, or any string with ' // ' before the path, escapes the lint. No current line is affected.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Acceptable as is; tighten only if a false negative shows up.
